for k,i in enumerate(p): print('smooth peak', round(x[i],1), round(ys[i]-base[i]), round(pr['prominences'][k]), round(pr['widths'][k]*0.91,1))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from lmfit import Model
from lmfit.models import LorentzianModel, GaussianModel, VoigtModel, LinearModel
d=pd.read_csv('spectrum.csv')
x=d.shift_cm1.values; y=d.intensity.values
def fit(centers, lo, hi, label):
    m=(x>lo)&(x<hi)
    mod=LinearModel(prefix='bg_')
    pars=mod.make_params(intercept=np.median(y[m]), slope=0)
    for k,c in enumerate(centers):
        p=LorentzianModel(prefix=f'p{k}_')
        pars.update(p.make_params(center=c, amplitude=max(y[m])*0.5, sigma=3))
        pars[f'p{k}_center'].set(min=c-5,max=c+5)
        pars[f'p{k}_sigma'].set(min=0.5,max=20)
        mod=mod+p
    r=mod.fit(y[m], pars, x=x[m])
    print(label, 'chi2red', round(r.redchi,0), 'ndata', m.sum())
    for k,c in enumerate(centers):
        print('  center', round(r.params[f'p{k}_center'].value,2), '+-', round(r.params[f'p{k}_center'].stderr or 0,2),
              'FWHM', round(2*r.params[f'p{k}_sigma'].value,2), 'amp', round(r.params[f'p{k}_height'].value,0), 'area', round(r.params[f'p{k}_amplitude'].value,0))
    return r

fit([471.7],440,500,'472 window')
fit([520.4],495,545,'520 window')
fit([322.9],300,345,'323 window')
"

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from lmfit import Model
from lmfit.models import LorentzianModel, LinearModel
d=pd.read_csv('spectrum.csv')
x=d.shift_cm1.values; y=d.intensity.values
def build(centers):
    mod=LinearModel(prefix='bg_')
    pars=mod.make_params(intercept=3400, slope=0)
    for k,c in enumerate(centers):
        p=LorentzianModel(prefix=f'p{k}_')
        pars.update(p.make_params(center=c, amplitude=3000, sigma=2))
        pars[f'p{k}_center'].set(min=c-3,max=c+3)
        pars[f'p{k}_sigma'].set(min=0.3,max=15)
        mod=mod+p
    return mod,pars
mod,pars=build([206.5,471.5,520.5])
r=mod.fit(y,pars,x=x)
print('3-peak full fit redchi',round(r.redchi), 'chi2', round(r.chisqr,3e0), 'AIC',round(r.aic,1))
for n,v in r.params.items():
    if 'center' in n or 'sigma' in n or 'intercept' in n or 'slope' in n: print(n, round(v.value,3), round(v.stderr or 0,3))
res=r.residual
print('resid std', res.std().round(1), 'max |res|', np.abs(res).max().round(0), 'at', x[np.argmax(np.abs(res))])
# add candidates one at a time
base_aic=r.aic
cands=[78.7,172.3,270.6,296.3,323,366,572.7,853.7,792,990,1100]
for c in cands:
    m2,p2=build([206.5,471.5,520.5,c])
    r2=m2.fit(y,p2,x=x)
    print('add', c, 'dAIC', round(r2.aic-base_aic,1), 'center', round(r2.params[f'p3_center'].value,1), 'amp', round(r2.params['p3_height'].value), 'fwhm', round(2*r2.params['p3_sigma'].value,1))
"
